test.summary: SPM - OKR - Creating Multi-Select type custom field
test.description:
This test verifies creation of a multi-select type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a multi-select type custom field with valid data
* Adding selectable options for the field
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field is available for all OKR types (Strategic Theme, Objective, Key Result)
* Verifying that a value can be selected during OKR creation
* Verifying that the selected value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views

Test: TC-6121 — SPM - OKR - Creating Multi-Select type custom field
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual

Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies creation of a multi-select type custom field using the creation modal and its correct behavior across the application.

* Creating a multi-select type custom field with valid data
* Adding selectable options for the field
* Verifying that the field appears in the Fields list
* Verifying that the field is visible in all relevant places:
** OKR Detail, Overview table, Side Panel, creation dialog, and tree view
* Verifying that the custom field is available for all OKR types (Strategic Theme, Objective, Key Result)
* Verifying that a value can be selected during OKR creation
* Verifying that the selected value is saved correctly and displayed in all supported views

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR settings → Fields of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6121 SPM - OKR - Creating Multi-select type custom field
   Expected: Fields settings page is displayed.
2. Click on "Create new" button.
   Expected: "Create custom field" modal is displayed.
3. Type field name, choose "Multi-select" field type, add 3 values as Select field options. Click Create button
   Data: * fieldName: Multi-select field
* valuesName:
** Frontend
** Backend
** QA
   Expected: Field is successfully created. New field appears in the "Your custom fields" list.
Field name, type, empty description and "Used in" values are displayed correctly
4. Open Overview → click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Multi-select field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
5. Enter strategic theme name, set period and choose value in multi-select field. Click Create
   Data: * stName: Strategic theme 1
* period: Y2026
* fieldValue: Frontend
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view. Multi-select field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
6. Click Add + button next to strategic theme and add objective
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Multi-select field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"

* period: Y2026
* fieldValue: Frontend, Backend

8. Click Add + button next to Objective and add Key result
   Expected: Creation modal is displayed. Multi-select field is visible in the OKR creation modal with default value "Not set"
9. Enter Key result name, set period and choose value in multi-select field. Click Create
   Data: * keyresultName: KR 1
* period: Y2026
* fieldValue: Frontend, Backend, QA
   Expected: Key result is created and visible in tree view. Multi-select field is visible in the right-side with correct value.
10. Open Overview and navigate to Multi-select field
   Expected: Multi-select field is visible in the Overview table for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key result with correct name and values.
11. Click on the grey area of the Strategic theme row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Strategic theme. Multi-select field is visible with correct name and value.
12. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. Multi-select field is visible with correct name and value.
13. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
